body: Finished runs, steps, signals and run-end outbox rows accumulate in the sqlstore tables forever. Add a retention policy (an option such as keep terminal runs for a duration, or a Prune(ctx, olderThan) call) that deletes terminal runs and their dependent rows in batches, never a run still holding an idempotency key or an undelivered run-end event. Prove it on SQLite, Postgres and MySQL.
title: sqlstore: retention of finished runs
